stock.description: China Demeter Financial Investments Limited, an investment holding company, operates in restaurant business in Hong Kong. It operates through Money Lending; Financial Services; Securities Investment; Food and Beverage; Alcoholic Beverage Distribution and Miscellaneous; and Children Education Services segments. The company’s restaurants serve Japanese cuisine, Thai food, and Western food. It also provides loan financing; financial services, such as advising and dealing in securities and asset management; children education services, including Kindergarten or pre-school education services; and administrative services. In addition, the company engages in alcoholic beverage distribution, including wine and whisky; investment in listed and unlisted securities; and trading of miscellaneous goods. The company was formerly known as China Demeter Investments Limited and changed its name to China Demeter Financial Investments Limited in December 2016. China Demeter Financial Investments Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
